result: Both confirmed findings resolved in source; no remaining actionable static finding
runtime_status: Native build and integrated VLC runtime validation pending

resolved_findings.problem: A queued STARTED(A) callback could be rejected after a continuous transition to B, leaving the stopped-model clear flag true. B emits no STARTED event, so its bookmarks stayed hidden.
resolved_findings.fix: The current-media callback captures vlc_player_GetState(player) under its existing player lock and applies the captured clear flag only after accepting the media revision, before starting the media lookup.
resolved_findings.verification: Traced delayed startup followed by continuous A-to-B transition, stopped media selection followed by start, stop during an outstanding lookup/refresh, stale older-media callbacks, and paused sessions. The accepted media snapshot now supplies the flag independently of a STARTED event.
supporting_api_evidence: include/vlc_player.h:202-207 documents omitted next-media state events during continuous playback.
include/vlc_player.h:2832-2835 permits player getters under the callback's existing lock.
src/player/player.c:1385-1388 shows GetState returns the locked global state.

resolved_findings.problem: The thread pool could read media ID zero before listener registration, while MEDIA_ADDED occurred in that interval. Events are not replayed, so the lookup could complete with no pending retry and leave bookmarks unready.
resolved_findings.fix: initModel registers the media library event listener before updateMediaId and does so after releasing both the player and model mutexes.
resolved_findings.verification: Subscription now precedes the initial read. Additions before subscription are visible to the later lookup; additions after an ID-zero read are observed by the registered listener and coalesced or retried. Registration introduces no player/model lock inversion.
supporting_api_evidence: modules/gui/qt/medialibrary/mlthreadpool.cpp:51-55 starts default-queue work in the thread pool immediately.
src/misc/medialibrary.c:54-78 sends events only to currently registered callbacks and synchronizes registration with the same callback-list mutex.

other_backend_checks_from_initial_review: Index ownership, bounds, invalid parent handling, and native multi-column selection deduplication.
Preserved existing role IDs and added timeMs compatible with the inline delegate.
Player-before-model mutex order, GUI-only model fields, and value captures for ML workers.
Player and media library listener replacement and synchronized unregister behavior.
Media, lookup, and refresh revision rejection after player, library, or media changes.
Null player and optional MediaLib guards, plus separate optional-module QML loading.
ThreadRunner target lifetime cancellation and owned async contexts.

remaining_native_gates.scope: Compile and link the modified C++ model and its moc-generated QML invokable/property interfaces.
Run the actual inline production QML adapter with VLC Player and MediaLib; confirm Add, Remove, selection-to-seek, and persisted name/timeMs data on real indexed media.
Exercise same-media stop/restart, continuous A-to-B transition with delayed GUI delivery, switches while lookups/refreshes are outstanding, and selection of another media while stopped.

Construct the bookmark helper while current media is playing and its database record appears during the initial lookup; verify readiness. Also run without an available media library to confirm the parent loader stays inactive and does not raise QML import/runtime errors.

limitations: Read-only repository review; this reviewer created only review artifacts outside the repository.
